- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

blocks.text:
# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

content.thinking:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

messages.preview: The Android build failed during NDK auto-install: `Error on ZipFile unknown archive` — the NDK 28.2.13676358 download came back truncated/corrupt. Let me look at how the NDK is requested and whether t…

blocks.text:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue
— must fail before the fix
— cover the exact scenario called out (including boundary/multi-item cases, not just the happy path)"] T2["GREEN: Make the minimum code change to turn the test PASS
— do not expand scope beyond the reported issue"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up while keeping tests GREEN

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

blocks.text:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

messages.preview: The Android build failed during NDK auto-install: `Error on ZipFile unknown archive` — the NDK 28.2.13676358 download came back truncated/corrupt. Let me look at how the NDK is requested and whether t…

blocks.text:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

messages.preview: The Android build failed during NDK auto-install: `Error on ZipFile unknown archive` — the NDK 28.2.13676358 download came back truncated/corrupt. Let me look at how the NDK is requested and whether t…

blocks.text:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

On the CI, Flutter stable 3.47.7 was used, and Gradle requested NDK 28.2.13676358 (android-ndk-r28c). "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" at 33%: the download jumped from 19% to 33% then immediately "Unzipping..." — this suggests the download actually FAILED fast and sdkmanager tried to unzip an incomplete file. That's classic transient network flake (connection cut mid-download → truncated archive).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

blocks.text:
Interesting. The Android build failed because:

```
Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358: Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
```

The NDK download was truncated at 33% — "Error on ZipFile unknown archive". This looks like an infra/network failure on the runner, NOT a code failure. The Gradle build at `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` line 73 invokes sdkmanager to install the NDK, and the download was corrupted/truncated.

Let me check the beginning of the log to see the workflow steps and whether previous runs of this build leg succeeded on this same commit. Let me also check the build.gradle.kts line 73 and whether the NDK version pinned matches an available one.

Key question: is this a flaky infra failure (partial download), or is the pinned NDK version invalid (e.g., removed from Google's repository)? "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" is the classic symptom of a truncated/corrupt download OR of a requested NDK version whose archive URL 404s (sdkmanager writes an HTML error page to the zip). If the NDK version is removed/invalid, sdkmanager reports "Error: The following Android SDK packages were not found" or similar; if it 404s mid-download, "Error on ZipFile" can appear.

Let me look at the full log to see how the NDK got requested. Line 73 of build.gradle.kts. Let me check the workflow definition for build-mobile.yml.

That's classic transient network flake (connection cut mid-download → truncated archive).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1656
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1656
- **Title**: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1655` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 2
- **Additions**: +267
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-16T14:03:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:24:47Z

## PR Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.

blocks.text:
# pr-1656: gh-1655 [BUG] aiin/JoinGonka relay stutter: doubled punctuation in thinking + duplicated tool-call execution

## Description

Closes #1655
### Root Cause

Stuttering OpenAI-compatible relays (JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7 via `aiin`) re-send stream frames; the shared adapter mishandled both shapes: `_dedupeOverlap` trimmed overlaps only for `k >= 2`, so a 1-char punctuation stutter survived (doubled punctuation in thinking), and `_ensureToolCallBlock` matched blocks only by `streamIndex`/`id`, so a re-sent call frame with a fresh id spawned a second identical block and executed the command twice.

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/openai_completions.dart`:
  - `_dedupeOverlap`: trim 1-char overlaps too, with an ellipsis guard (a delta repeating its leading char is a legit `...` continuation, not a seam); full-snapshot branch and 64-char window unchanged.
  - `_ensureToolCallBlock` + new `_matchResentToolCallBlock`: on a lookup miss, a frame whose name equals the last registered block's name with `partialArgs` empty or a prefix of the incoming args is a re-send — merge into that block (newer id adopted only if the old is empty), appending only the non-overlapping argument suffix.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`: stutter-trim (`greeting`, `.`, `.` → `greeting. I should`), ellipsis intact (`hmm`, `.`, `..` → `hmm...`), re-sent frame with fresh id → ONE block/one execution, distinct calls → two blocks. All failed-before/green-after as specified.
- Existing sliding-window fixture updated: `'Продолжжжжаем'` → `'Продолжжжаем'` (it baked in the surviving 1-char stutter); clean-delta cases byte-identical (C4).
- Full suite: 6549 passed, 19 failed — all 19 verified pre-existing on the clean base commit (`124f1e0`) via a detached worktree run (env-dependent PTY/CLI suites already red on main per gh-1649); provider suites: 827/827 green.

### Notes

- Merge fires only on an id/index lookup miss — clean relays are unaffected by construction.
- AC4 (live `aiin/JoinGonka/MiniMax-M2.7` check) is not executable in this environment; the fixtures reproduce both observed defects at the adapter level.
