{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.

## Test Coverage

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

blocks.text:
name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`).
- `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` → **76 passed** (adjacent guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green on this tree).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**.
- `shellcheck` (with shebang) on the extracted action script → clean; `bash -n` → OK; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run against the frozen tree — result reported in the follow-up validation run; the sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps

blocks.text:
name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"

          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true

        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`).

- `shellcheck` (with shebang) on the extracted action script → clean; `bash -n` → OK; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run against the frozen tree — result reported in the follow-up validation run; the sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The

blocks.text:
name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`).
- `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` → **76 passed** (adjacent guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green on this tree).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**.
- `shellcheck` (with shebang) on the extracted action script → clean; `bash -n` → OK; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run against the frozen tree — result reported in the follow-up validation run; the sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only

blocks.text:
name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`).
- `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` → **76 passed** (adjacent guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green on this tree).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**.
- `shellcheck` (with shebang) on the extracted action script → clean; `bash -n` → OK; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run against the frozen tree — result reported in the follow-up validation run; the sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.

blocks.text:
name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it is green in CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate`, provider suites all `success` on the failing run) and locally (76/76 in `test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart`).

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`).
- `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` → **76 passed** (adjacent guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green on this tree).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**.
- `shellcheck` (with shebang) on the extracted action script → clean; `bash -n` → OK; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run against the frozen tree — result reported in the follow-up validation run; the sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`

flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
