# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it was green in the failing run's own CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate` all `success`) and is green locally in this rework (`test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` inside the 153-test guard-class run).
- Local full-suite attempts were killed twice by the rework sandbox recycling between turns (`/tmp` and background jobs do not survive); the covered portion (2400+ lines, all of `test/agent` + much of `test/cli`) showed the single failure `test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart` theme-token spot check — a reg-parity fixture-dependent suite. This diff touches zero production Dart code (`.github/` workflows/action + one additive `test/` file), so that failure is by construction unrelated; the sharded validation CI on the pushed head re-runs the full suite as the safety net.

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.

- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it was green in the failing run's own CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate` all `success`) and is green locally in this rework (`test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` inside the 153-test guard-class run).
- Local full-suite attempts were killed twice by the rework sandbox recycling between turns (`/tmp` and background jobs do not survive); the covered portion (2400+ lines, all of `test/agent` + much of `test/cli`) showed the single failure `test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart` theme-token spot check — a reg-parity fixture-dependent suite. This diff touches zero production Dart code (`.github/` workflows/action + one additive `test/` file), so that failure is by construction unrelated; the sharded validation CI on the pushed head re-runs the full suite as the safety net.

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only). Verified no other workflow compiles Android (`store-metadata.yml` rides the upload-only fastlane lane; `aab-gate-selftest.yml` tests the verify script on fixtures; `daily-publish.yml` dispatches `build-mobile.yml`).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

- `shellcheck` + `bash -n` on the extracted action script (final committed bytes) → clean; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` was launched twice against the frozen tree; both runs were killed by sandbox recycles between turns (see Issues/Notes). The sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head — validation CI is the full-suite proof.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);

{"content":"# PR #1656 rework — CI red root cause fixed: unretryable mid-build NDK download

## Issues/Notes

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it was green in the failing run's own CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate` all `success`) and is green locally in this rework (`test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` inside the 153-test guard-class run).
- Local full-suite attempts were killed twice by the rework sandbox recycling between turns (`/tmp` and background jobs do not survive); the covered portion (2400+ lines, all of `test/agent` + much of `test/cli`) showed the single failure `test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart` theme-token spot check — a reg-parity fixture-dependent suite. This diff touches zero production Dart code (`.github/` workflows/action + one additive `test/` file), so that failure is by construction unrelated; the sharded validation CI on the pushed head re-runs the full suite as the safety net.

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only). Verified no other workflow compiles Android (`store-metadata.yml` rides the upload-only fastlane lane; `aab-gate-selftest.yml` tests the verify script on fixtures; `daily-publish.yml` dispatches `build-mobile.yml`).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`). Re-verified green on the merged head (`f856d6ce` — main re-synced mid-rework — and the WIP auto-save `e230719` on top).
- Guard-class regression run: `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart test/ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart test/workflow_fetch_shape_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` → **153 passed** (adjacent gh-1468 guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green; the whole CI-guard class this file joins undisturbed).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**; `dart format` clean (stable across re-runs).
- `shellcheck` + `bash -n` on the extracted action script (final committed bytes) → clean; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` was launched twice against the frozen tree; both runs were killed by sandbox recycles between turns (see Issues/Notes). The covered portion surfaced only the pre-existing, unrelated `omp_reg_parity` fixture failure. The sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head — validation CI is the full-suite proof.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

- Both failed checks on head `96d3a8f` share one root cause. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed in Gradle *configuration*, before any of the PR's code compiled; **Quality gate** is only the aggregate echoing that platform leg (`build-android: failure` → `Quality gate FAILED: a platform/native leg is red`, per the run's own verdict line).
- Failure signature (job `117223877718`, `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store`):

  ```
  [=======                                 ] 19% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  [============                            ] 33% Downloading android-ndk-r28c-linux
  Warning: An error occurred while preparing SDK package NDK (Side by side) 28.2.13676358:
    Error on ZipFile unknown archive.
  * Where: flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts line: 73
  A problem occurred configuring project ':app'.
  > Process 'command '/usr/local/lib/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager'' finished with non-zero exit value 1
  ```

- **Deterministic-or-flake check**: the same job on `main` (run `38976075682`, started 22:30:49Z — 4 minutes after the red PR run) downloaded the **same** `android-ndk-r28c-linux` via the **same** sdkmanager and went green. The app reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` (Flutter 3.47.7 → `28.2.13676358`); the transfer died mid-stream and the partial bytes were unzipped as a corrupt archive. Not a code defect, not a dependency drift — a runner-network roulette riding an **unretryable** path: AGP auto-installs the NDK inside Gradle configuration, which has no retry.
- The two "open review threads" (`pr_discussions_raw.json` indices 3–4) are machine notices with `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` — the red-CI arming audit and the rework-consume marker. The discussions header itself marks them "arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets", and the rules forbid inventing ids; `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`. Their demand — a green head — is what this fix produces.
- The PR's own gh-1655 adapter code (stutter dedupe + tool-call re-send merge) was left untouched: it was green in the failing run's own CI (`test-core`, `flutter-analyze`, `flutter-tests`, `coverage-gate` all `success`) and is green locally in this rework (`test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart` inside the 153-test guard-class run).
- Local full-suite attempts were killed twice by the rework sandbox recycling between turns (`/tmp` and background jobs do not survive); the covered portion (2400+ lines, all of `test/agent` + much of `test/cli`) showed the single failure `test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart` theme-token spot check — a reg-parity fixture-dependent suite. This diff touches zero production Dart code (`.github/` workflows/action + one additive `test/` file), so that failure is by construction unrelated; the sharded validation CI on the pushed head re-runs the full suite as the safety net.

## Approach

- Follow the established repo pattern for exactly this failure class — gh-1468's flutter_gemma seed ("one CDN 500 red'd this leg and the aggregate Quality gate" → pre-fetch outside the unretryable mid-build path, bounded retry, idempotent skip), guarded by a static YAML guard test per the `ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart` convention.
- New composite action `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`:
  - resolves the NDK version from the pinned Flutter SDK's gradle plugin source (`FlutterExtension.kt`, `val ndkVersion`) — the exact value `flutter.ndkVersion` resolves to, so there is no second pin to drift (AC5 proves the extraction against the real SDK: `28.2.13676358`);
  - skips when `$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version>/source.properties` already exists (AGP's own lookup path → no download at Gradle config time);
  - accepts pending licenses, then installs via `sdkmanager --install "ndk;<version>"` with **3 attempts + 10s backoff**, cleaning any partial target dir per attempt;
  - fails loudly with `::error::` when the version cannot be resolved or all attempts fail.
- Wired into every Android-building job (gh-1310: fix the whole class): `ci.yml` `build-android`, `build-mobile.yml` `build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml` `build-release` (android matrix row only). Verified no other workflow compiles Android (`store-metadata.yml` rides the upload-only fastlane lane; `aab-gate-selftest.yml` tests the verify script on fixtures; `daily-publish.yml` dispatches `build-mobile.yml`).
- TDD: RED first — `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` run against the unfixed tree failed 12/14 (missing action, missing pre-install in all four jobs, missing references); GREEN after the action + wiring (14/14).

## Files Modified

- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — new composite action (resolve → skip-if-present → license-accept → 3-attempt retry install).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `build-android`: pre-install the NDK before `flutter build apk (debug)`.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` — `build-android` (AAB) and `build-android-apks` (store/god matrix): same pre-install before each build step.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — `build-release`: same pre-install on the android matrix row.
- `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` — new guard (AC1–AC5, 14 tests): composite/action shape, SDK-source version resolution (no drift pin), loud failure, idempotent skip, bounded retry, pre-build ordering in every Android job, exact reference counts, `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion` coupling, and the extraction matched against a real SDK.

## Test Coverage

- **RED → GREEN**: guard run before the fix — `2 tests passed, 12 failed` (every AC1/AC2/AC3 assertion red); after the fix — `14 tests passed` (AC5 prints `extraction matches — flutter.ndkVersion = 28.2.13676358`). Re-verified green on the merged head (`f856d6ce` — main re-synced mid-rework — and the WIP auto-save `e230719` on top).
- Guard-class regression run: `dart test test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart test/providers/openai_completions_test.dart test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart test/ci_pty_artifact_upload_retry_guard_test.dart test/workflow_fetch_shape_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_pending_guard_test.dart test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart` → **153 passed** (adjacent gh-1468 guard intact; the PR's stutter/re-send fixtures green; the whole CI-guard class this file joins undisturbed).
- `dart analyze test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` → **No issues found**; `dart format` clean (stable across re-runs).
- `shellcheck` + `bash -n` on the extracted action script (final committed bytes) → clean; all four YAML files parse (the guard `loadYaml`s each).
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` was launched twice against the frozen tree; both runs were killed by sandbox recycles between turns (see Issues/Notes). The covered portion surfaced only the pre-existing, unrelated `omp_reg_parity` fixture failure. The sharded CI legs (`test-core` ×4, `coverage-gate`) re-run the same set with coverage on the new head — validation CI is the full-suite proof.
- The sdkmanager install path itself is only executable on a GitHub runner (no Android SDK in this sandbox); it is bounded by the retry loop and its failure mode is a loud `::error::` — validation CI on the pushed head is the end-to-end proof.

content.text:
All artifacts verified. Final state summary:

**Root cause**: the Android leg died mid-Gradle-configuration on a truncated NDK download (`Error on ZipFile unknown archive` at 33%) — AGP's auto-install path has no retry; the same download succeeded on `main` four minutes later, proving flake, not code.

**Fix** (TDD, RED→GREEN): new `android-ndk-preinstall` composite action — resolves the version from the pinned Flutter SDK's own gradle source (no drift pin), skips if already installed, installs with 3-attempt retry — wired into all four Android-building jobs (`ci.yml build-android`, `build-mobile.yml build-android` + `build-android-apks`, `nightly.yml build-release`), guarded by a new 14-test static guard (`test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart`) that failed 12/14 before the fix.

The one `fail` item is environmental, not a tree defect: full-suite verification is explicitly delegated to validation CI on the pushed head (which re-runs the identical `dart test --exclude-tags integration` set, sharded ×4, plus coverage) — every suite touching this change (guard class, provider fixtures, adjacent guards, analyze, format, shellcheck, YAML parse) was verified green locally.
